question: The general term is \(a_n=4n−1\). What is the common difference?
solution: The coefficient of the linear term, 4, is the common difference.

solutionMethods.explanation:
The common difference is the change from any term to the next. For every positive integer \(n\),
\[
a_{n+1}-a_n=[4(n+1)-1]-(4n-1)=4.
\]
This difference is constant, so the common difference is \(4\).
solutionMethods.label: Use the common-difference definition

reference.solution:
Method 1: Read the coefficient

The coefficient of the linear term, 4, is the common difference.

Method 2: Use the common-difference definition

The common difference is the change from any term to the next. For every positive integer \(n\),
\[
a_{n+1}-a_n=[4(n+1)-1]-(4n-1)=4.
\]
This difference is constant, so the common difference is \(4\).
